seoTitle: tsconfig.json Explainer: Every Option in Plain Words
metaDescription: Paste a tsconfig.json and get a short plain-language note for each option, plus a review list for unknown or risky settings. Runs in your browser.
intro: Annotates each option in a tsconfig.json with what it does and flags unknown option names and a few risky combinations.
why:
A tsconfig often contains options copied from a template, and nobody remembers why. This page gives one line per option so you can decide what to keep. Comments and trailing commas are accepted, as in a real tsconfig.

Option names were checked against the TSConfig Reference. The notes are short summaries I wrote, and defaults change between TypeScript versions, so confirm details in the reference before changing a build.
howTo: Read each entry and its note.
Check the Review list for unknown names and risky settings.
Look up anything unclear in the TSConfig Reference.
